يقترن (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِنُ (yaqtarinu) /jaq.ta.ri.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
# يَقْتَرِنَّ (yaqtarinna) /jaq.ta.rin.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
# يُقْتَرَنُ (yuqtaranu) /juq.ta.ra.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
